opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A); up to £500 (Scheme B); up to £750 (Adelphi co-sponsored); up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; UK‑based members for non‑Society meetings; one grant per two years for Schemes B/C.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences (Society meetings, non‑Society meetings, and virtual conferences) with travel, accommodation and registration costs.

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK; students must be members; others need one year membership; UK‑based training courses only.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to support attendance at short genetics‑related training courses or collaborative lab visits for skill development.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports members to deliver public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and material costs (UK‑based travel only).

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Sponsorship Grant

amount.raw: Typically between £1,000 and £2,000; up to several thousand possible for major sponsorship.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members proposing UK‑based genetics‑themed meetings; applications accepted at any time.
opportunities.summary: Provides sponsorship for genetic‑themed meetings not organised directly by the Society, covering venue, speaker, and related costs, with optional Carer’s Award.
